purpose: Unknown/duplicate names fail before either frame; count/type failures retain Gen API plus source Closure wrapper frames, then ordinary valid named invocation recovers. Its final successful call uses computed nullsafe __invoke and the ordinary result handoff.
source:
<?php
function stream113A() { echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|'; yield 'tail'; return 113; }
function warning113A($severity, $message) { echo 'BAD-WARN|'; return true; }
function frames113A($error, $method, $arguments) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo 'FRAMES|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === $method, '|', $trace[0]['file'] === __FILE__, '|', isset($trace[0]['line']) && $trace[0]['line'] === $trace[1]['line'], '|',
        $trace[0]['args'] === $arguments, '|', $trace[1]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === '__invoke', '|', $trace[1]['args'] === $arguments, '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
}
$generator = stream113A(); $send = $generator->send(...); $throw = $generator->throw(...); $next = $generator->next(...); $getReturn = $generator->getReturn(...);
set_error_handler('warning113A');
try { $send->__invoke(extra: $missing); }
catch (Error $error) { echo 'UNKNOWN|', $error->getMessage() === 'Unknown named parameter $extra', '|', $error->getTrace() === [], '|'; }
restore_error_handler();
try { $send->__invoke(...[41], ...['value' => 42]); }
catch (Error $error) { echo 'DUP|', $error->getMessage() === 'Named parameter $value overwrites previous argument', '|', $error->getTrace() === [], '|'; }
try { $send->__invoke(...['value' => 41], ...[42]); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { echo 'COUNT2|'; frames113A($error, 'send', [41, 42]); }
try { $send->__invoke(); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { echo 'COUNT0|'; frames113A($error, 'send', []); }
try { $throw->__invoke(exception: 17); }
catch (TypeError $error) { echo 'TYPE|'; frames113A($error, 'throw', [17]); }
$invoke = '__invoke'; echo 'SEND|', $send?->{$invoke}(value: 41), '|';
$next->__invoke(...[]); echo 'RETURN|', $getReturn->__invoke(), '|';

purpose: The inner result is used by the wrapper even when source ignores it; an outer argument destructor advances Gen and must still see the payload copy before outer unused-result cleanup.
source:
<?php
class Payload113B {
    function __construct() { global $weakPayload; $weakPayload = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() { global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture; echo 'PAYLOAD|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|'; }
}
class Argument113B {
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture, $weakPayload;
        echo 'ARG|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|';
        $generator = $weakGenerator->get(); $generator->next();
        echo 'AFTER-NEXT|', $weakPayload->get() instanceof Payload113B, '|';
    }
}
function stream113B() {
    global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture;
    try { echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; unset($value); yield new Payload113B(); echo 'ADVANCE|'; yield 'after'; }
    finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function pack113B() { global $capture; $capture = null; return ['value' => new Argument113B()]; }
$generator = stream113B(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
$capture = $generator->send(...); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $generator = null;
echo 'CALL|'; $capture->__invoke(...pack113B());
echo 'AFTER|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|', $weakPayload->get() === null, '|';

purpose: An ignored explicit wrapper return drops its copy before capture retirement even after the outer argument destructor throws. The remaining Generator cache destroys Return while Generator storage is weak-live; the capture is already weak-dead. Supplied exception identity and empty original trace survive.
source:
<?php
class Stop113U extends Exception {}
class Return113U { function __destruct() { global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture; echo 'RET|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; } }
class Argument113U { function __destruct() { global $stop; echo 'ARG|'; throw $stop; } }
function stream113U() {
    global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture;
    try { $value = yield 'head'; unset($value); yield new Return113U(); }
    finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function pack113U() { global $capture; $capture = null; return ['value' => new Argument113U()]; }
$stop = new Stop113U('given'); $generator = stream113U(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
$capture = $generator->send(...); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $generator = null;
try { echo 'CALL|'; $capture->__invoke(...pack113U()); echo 'BAD|'; }
catch (Stop113U $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
echo 'DONE|';
